source_name: Time Out Riyadh Restaurant Awards 2025 — winners (partial)
coverage_note: timeoutriyadh.com, timeoutdoha.com, timeoutdubai.com, hoteliermiddleeast.com, caterermiddleeast.com and arabianbusiness.com all returned bot-protection blocks (403/405) to this session, so the full winners page could not be read. Fourth edition, ceremony 10 Sep 2025 at voco Riyadh; shortlist of 240+ venues in 26 categories. Only two category winners could be confirmed from search-result summaries of Time Out pages tagged Restaurant Awards 2025; Restaurant of the Year 2025, other winners and highly commended venues are missing. A 2026 edition appears to exist (Time Out 2026 guide pages mention venues crowned at the awards) but could not be verified, so no 2026 file was written.
